title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：statistic　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 statistic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the researcher ① checked the statistic that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the checking was the whole of the term. The ② statistic, meaning the figure itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a statistic, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ statistic in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ statistic at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A statistic, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the statistic was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the figure. The ⑥ statistic, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; statistic, he said, is either something you check or the only word that means both a figure and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ statistic had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ statistic of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; statistic, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ statistic I remember is the figure noted in the paper, which closed in 1979 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ statistic, my mother said in 1981, is the only figure that improves by being noted; every statistic, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 统计数字（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 统计数字（指那个统计数字本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：check the statistic 核对这一个统计数字
D. n. 统计数字（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 统计数字之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的统计数字之事）
F. n. 统计数字（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 统计数字、实情（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 实情（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: checked the statistic that no student in the lab would have noted
The statistic, meaning the figure itself and not the tube
the statistic at the far bench
the statistic was the whole of the matter
the statistic had become a line in a paper
The statistic of the whole thing
A statistic, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: check the statistic 意为“核对这一个统计数字”，1972 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一个统计数字做了一遍。
statistic 意为“统计数字”，指那个统计数字本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
statistic 意为“统计数字”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
statistic 意为“统计数字”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
statistic 意为“统计数字、实情”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个实情就是那件事的全部。
statistic 意为“实情”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个统计数字，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
statistic 意为“统计数字”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1977 年这一个成了研究报告里的一行。
statistic 意为“统计数字之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的统计数字之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
statistic 意为“统计数字”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一个，1979 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
statistic 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，统计数字是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的统计数字。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

那个统计数字，指的是那个统计数字本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（statistic）
